claims.text: Variance is reduced by using Expected Gradient Length (EGL), which computes the expectation of the gradient norm over all possible labelings to identify informative instances.
EGL is implemented by marginalizing over the most probable labelings obtained through beam search decoding, which helps in estimating the gradient norms effectively.
